name: obstudio
description: Obstudio bundles local OpenTelemetry workflows, observer controls, and help for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: OpenTelemetry workflows and observer controls for Codex.
interface.longDescription:
Obstudio adds local OpenTelemetry audit, app and Collector config generation, instrumentation, verification, Splunk publish workflows, observer controls, and a help skill to Codex.

How to get started:
1. Install the Obstudio plugin.
2. Trust the SessionStart hook when Codex prompts you to review it. You can also review the Obstudio plugin hooks from Codex plugin settings and trust the hook there.
3. Try one of these actions: open the local Observer with $observer-open, check Observer health with $observer-status, audit this repo for observability gaps with $otel-audit, generate app and Collector config with $otel-generate-app-collector-config, add instrumentation for selected findings with $otel-instrument, or verify emitted telemetry with $otel-verify.
defaultPrompt: Audit this repo for observability gaps.
Verify instrumentation and suggest GenAI telemetry improvements.
